scope: Finite-cutoff sampled lower-gap maps at R2 and R4, c and d. No certified touching, count, charge, partner correspondence, continuous isolation or infinite-cutoff claim.

stage2_rule.claims: finite-cutoff numerical evidence consistent with candidate lo−1/lo touchings; 014 is region-level discrete-loop evidence only
stage2_rule.execution: Separate frozen run only after stage-1 results are posted; no stage-2 physical calls in this run
stage2_rule.fit: Per cutoff and region, least-squares quadratic lower-gap-squared fit using columns u^2,v^2,uv,u,v,1 in grid-step coordinates over all 81 samples; descriptive only.
stage2_rule.grid: 9x9 exact rational grid at step 2^-15 centered on each selected stage-1 minimum, evaluated at c and d; deduplicate identical coordinates before freezing stage 2.
stage2_rule.invalid_fit: Report invalid/outside fit and do not invent a fitted point or execute its loop; document in separate stage-2 freeze.
stage2_rule.loop: For each positive-definite fitted quadratic whose stationary point is inside the grid, round the fitted fractional coordinate to denominator 2^30 using ties-to-even; exact 32-point CCW square, half-width 2^-16, eight points per side starting lower-left, close last-to-first; evaluate c,d and report lo-1,lo,hi,pair,four signs.
stage2_rule.selection: For each region and each cutoff c,d, use its stage-1 sampled lower-gap minimum; exact ties choose smallest y then x (row-major frozen order).
